hammer_candle_long_side_mes_5m.extraction_audit_note: 12 JUSTIFIED_MANDATORY spine conditions remain executed under struct_all (matches conjunction_depth=12 exactly). Checked against transcript NMUd0oX_7Pg: 'sharp red move downward' <- "Take the hammer on the long side. This needs to appear after a clear sharp red move downward" (genuinely transcript-supported, describes the manipulation-candle PHASE 1 event). 'next candle to break above hammer high' <- "Wait for the next candle to break above the hammer high" (genuinely transcript-supported, describes PHASE 3: a specific level-break relative to the hammer candle's OWN high, drawn earlier). Both are real, non-inflated concepts per the DRI audit -- the audit did not over-classify. The problem is entirely at the BINDING layer, not the classification layer (see execution trace).
hammer_candle_long_side_mes_5m.binding_blocker: WAIT_BIAS:'sharp red move downward' (bearish EMA-lean proxy, fast<slow) vs WAIT_BIAS:'bullish reversal'+'directional push' (bullish EMA-lean proxy, fast>slow, identical shared array) -- pairwise joint_rate == 0.0 exactly while each individually >0.42-0.53. These are logical complements of the SAME instantaneous fast/slow EMA comparison evaluated with opposite polarity, so their conjunction is mathematically impossible on any single bar, not merely empirically rare.
hammer_candle_long_side_mes_5m.classified_outcome: TEMPORAL_INTERACTION (primary, Stage 3) with REPRESENTATION_LIMIT as the causal secondary (Stage 4): the transcript concept is an explicit 3-phase state machine (1: box+confirm the opening manipulation candle via ATR%; 2: wait, OUTSIDE the box, within a 60-90min window, for a hammer/engulfing reversal candle; 3: enter on the break of the NEXT candle above THAT SPECIFIC hammer candle's own high) requiring a bearish move to occur EARLIER and a bullish reversal LATER plus a session-anchored specific price level (the hammer's own high) carried forward across bars. The instantaneous-AND representation evaluates 'sharp red move downward' and 'bullish reversal'/'directional push' via the SAME same-bar EMA-slope proxy with opposite required polarity (structurally 0 joint probability) and evaluates 'next candle to break above hammer high' via the SAME generic structure_engine activity array as 'first 15 minutes candle formed today' (no memory of which specific candle or level is being broken). No amount of demotion can fix this -- it requires stateful/sequential execution semantics the current instantaneous-AND spine cannot express.

corpus_verdict.note: The two concepts fail via ENTIRELY DIFFERENT mechanisms (3 instances each), not merely different individual conditions within the same mechanism class -- so per the letter of the pre-registered table the closest single row is 'Different conditions block each' (RESIDUAL_DRI_INFLATION / extend the DRI taxonomy), but that label is only a partial fit: 5m_minute_support_level's blocker is NOT a DRI-classification-inflation issue at all (the DRI audit correctly found zero JUSTIFIED_MANDATORY content on its 1-member spine -- the defect is a Stage-1 ROLE-ASSIGNMENT gap upstream of the DRI classification layer: genuine transcript content was filed role='confluence' instead of role='spine', and the sole spine slot is a type-mismatched WAIT_SESSION that never binds). hammer_candle_long_side's blocker IS well-classified by the DRI audit (12 genuinely JUSTIFIED_MANDATORY, transcript-confirmed) but fails at Stage 3/4: TEMPORAL_INTERACTION (co-satisfaction structurally 0.0 for the bearish/bullish EMA-lean pair) caused by REPRESENTATION_LIMIT (the concept is an explicit sequential 3-phase state machine with a session-anchored specific price level that the instantaneous-AND spine cannot express).

corpus_verdict.recommended_next_step: (a) Add a 5th DRI-adjacent taxonomy class for role-assignment defects (spine structurally empty/mistyped despite real transcript content existing) -- this is invisible to the existing OPTIONAL/ALTERNATIVE/CONTEXTUAL/JUSTIFIED_MANDATORY/UNRESOLVED classification because it operates one layer above it (role, not classification). (b) hammer_candle_long_side is a clean, concrete case for the Layer-2 sequencing/state work GPT flagged: needs (i) a session-anchored level store (remember the opening 15m candle's own high/low across subsequent bars) and (ii) phase-ordered condition evaluation (bearish-phase THEN bullish-phase, not same-bar AND) rather than a purely instantaneous per-bar AND of all spine conditions.

summary: 6/6 instances traced on real S3 5m data (23786/23780/22992 bars MES/MNQ/MCL respectively) under TF_ROLE_DEMOTION_MODE=struct_all via the production SpecConditionStrategy path (from_compiled_spec + compute()). NEITHER concept's zero-trade symptom is explained by genuinely-mandatory conditions surviving demotion in the way the experiment's design anticipated for both concepts equally: (1) 5m_minute_support_level x3 -- spine is EMPTY (conjunction_depth==0) in ALL 6 demotion arms including baseline; the only spine-role condition is DRI-classified ALTERNATIVE (not JUSTIFIED_MANDATORY) and fails to bind (mistyped WAIT_SESSION); real concept content lives entirely in role='confluence' conditions the demotion axis cannot promote. Caught at Stage 1 (Extraction Audit) -- a role-assignment defect, not a condition-survives-demotion story. (2) hammer_candle_long_side x3 -- 12 JUSTIFIED_MANDATORY conditions survive struct_all exactly as expected, transcript-confirmed genuine, but collapse to only 4 DISTINCT executable arrays (structure-activity x2, candle-confirmation x4, bearish-EMA-lean x1, bullish-EMA-lean x2). The bearish-lean and bullish-lean arrays are exact logical complements of the SAME same-bar EMA comparison -- pairwise joint_rate == 0.0 exactly (confirmed on real data: e.g. MES rates 0.476 and 0.524, joint 0.0) -- a structural impossibility, not empirical rarity. Caught at Stage 3 (Temporal Audit), with Stage 4 (Representation Limit) as the causal mechanism: the transcript concept is an explicit multi-phase, session-anchored state machine the instantaneous-AND spine architecturally cannot express.
